Definition. Knot-indexed bi-filtration \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)} on the substrate convolution algebra

Definition (knot-indexed bi-filtration \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)} on the substrate convolution algebra).

Let \mathcal{H}_q be the substrate convolution Hopf algebra (Frobenius–Hopf substrate), filtered by iterated-integral depth G^{(0)} \subseteq G^{(1)} \subseteq \cdots (depth correspondence). For each Bring-embeddable knot/link K (Bring-embeddable knots) with dominant cell \lambda_K \vdash n_K and central primitive idempotent e_{\lambda_K} \in Z(H_{n_K}(q)) (explicit central idempotent), the knot-K-localised depth-n stratum is

  \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)}
  \;:=\;
  \bigl\{\, \alpha \;\in\; G^{(n)}(\mathcal{H}_q)
        \;:\; e_{\lambda_K} \cdot \alpha \cdot e_{\lambda_K} = \alpha \,\bigr\}.

The double-indexed family \{\mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)}\}_{n \geq 0,\;K} is the bi-filtration: a horizontal axis of iterated-integral depth n (Goncharov side) and a vertical axis of knot/braid class K (Hecke cell side).

Axes and refinements

Depth axis n (horizontal). Inherited from conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence: G^{(0)} contains \exp_q and scalars; G^{(n)} adjoins the grouplikes \log_q, \mathrm{Li}_2^q, \ldots, \mathrm{Li}_n^q. Compatible with \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} via \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}(G^{(n)}) \subseteq \mathcal{P}_n.

Knot axis K (vertical). Refined by partition cell \lambda_K. Two natural sub-axes inside the K-axis:

  1. Bar-class. Self-conjugate \lambda_K = \lambda_K' vs chiral pair \lambda_K \neq \lambda_K' (cf. rem:chirality-period-pairing).
  2. Genus. g(K) \leq 4 for Bring-embeddable (rem:bring-embeddable-knots).

Compatibility with the Hopf and braid structures

The bi-filtration interacts with the existing structures on \mathcal{H}_q:

Operation Effect on (n, K)
Convolution *_q (q-shuffle) \mathcal{H}_q^{(n_1, K_1)} *_q \mathcal{H}_q^{(n_2, K_2)} \subseteq \bigoplus \mathcal{H}_q^{(n_1 + n_2, K')} where K' ranges over cell-mergings
Coproduct \Delta_q \Delta_q(\mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)}) \subseteq \bigoplus_{n_1 + n_2 = n,\,K_1 \otimes K_2 = K} \mathcal{H}_q^{(n_1, K_1)} \otimes \mathcal{H}_q^{(n_2, K_2)}
Bar involution * \colon q \mapsto q^{-1} * \colon \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)} \to \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K^*)} where K^* is the mirror knot
Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M \mathrm{tr}_M \colon \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)} \to \mathcal{P}_n / \mathcal{P}_{n-1} — depth-preserving, knot-evaluating
Braid action of \beta \in B_{n_K} \beta \cdot \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)} \subseteq \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, \beta \cdot K)} where \beta \cdot K is the conjugate braid closure

The bi-filtration as a tooling unification

This is the definition layer for the framework the depth correspondence implies but does not name. Three downstream conjectures populate it:

  • conj:joint-galois-braid-action — the symmetry group acting on \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)}.
  • prop:knot-indexed-convolution-grid — placement of paper's existing knot-indexed convolutions (\mathrm{Lk}_R^{(k)}, \bowtie_K, Markov trace, Hoefsmit pairing, Higgs-vev coupling) into the (n, K)-grid.
  • rem:k-theory-period-rosetta — Beilinson regulator on K_{2n-1}^{\mathrm{ind}}(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) matches the depth-n axis.
